name: Omniscience
short_description: Self-hosted MCP retrieval with bitemporal replay and audit.
long_description: Omniscience is a self-hosted, MCP-first knowledge retrieval service. It indexes your sources (code, docs, infra configs, tickets, wikis, Datadog, PagerDuty, runbooks) and exposes them as MCP tools to any AI client - Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, custom agents. Retrieval-only: returns chunks with citations, letting the calling LLM synthesize the answer. Bitemporal storage means every fact is queryable as-of any past timestamp, enabling deterministic replay for incident review and AI-action auditing. Includes blast-radius and runbook-suggestion tools tuned for SRE and platform teams.

install.one_line: curl -fsSL -o install.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/100rd/Omniscience/v0.5.0/.mcp/install.sh && echo '080551789e472af099aa9e60554a3ac28a30a7fa98dd1c80c9a0698b5eff7ca1  install.sh' | sha256sum -c - && bash install.sh
install.uvx: uvx --from omniscience-cli omniscience mcp serve --transport stdio

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval across all indexed sources; returns chunks with citations and freshness metadata.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a specific document/chunk by ID.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List configured connectors and their freshness state.

tools.name: describe_source
tools.description: Describe a connector's schema, throughput, and last-sync time.

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Replay the retrieval result an agent would have seen at a past timestamp T.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Given an incident or change, return the impacted resources via the topology graph.

tools.name: suggest_runbook
tools.description: Match an incident signature against indexed runbooks and return the top candidates with confidence.

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Bitemporal timeline of changes for an entity, queryable as-of any past timestamp.
